posts.en:
dsh-session-sync is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Cross-device session sync: a dedicated git mirror with append-only three-way merging (keep-both + fork conflict resolution), a /sync command, and automatic push/pull.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-211efdd109b2da1e9e98.html
